comments.author: participant3
comments.body:
A potential fix might be to deactivate the initial response cache in SiS by adding the following to the `.streamlit/config.toml` in the app directory:

```
[snowflake.responseCache]
initialResponseCache = false
```

We are not sure if this actually resolves the issue, but it would help us to identify the root cause if you could try this setting and provide feedback if you still run into the issue.

comments.author: participant3
comments.body:
**Update:** we have identified the issue in SiS and are rolling out a fix soon. In the meantime, the recommended workaround is to either:
- Downgrading the Streamlit version to 1.44.1
- Disable the initial response cache via `.streamlit/config.toml`:

```
[snowflake.responseCache]
initialResponseCache = false
```
